scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const p=process.platform;const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{if(p==='win32'){execSync('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build-tray.ps1',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{execSync('bash build-tray.sh',{stdio:'inherit'})}}catch(e){console.error('Tray build skipped:',e.message)}"
scripts.update: npm run build && node -e "const p=process.platform;const {execSync}=require('child_process');if(p==='win32'){execSync('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File restart-tray.ps1',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{execSync('bash restart-tray.sh',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
